questions.question: In January 2023, the legislative bill providing ________ reservation to women in state government jobs has been approved by Uttarakhand Governor, Lt Gen (Retd.) Gurmit Singh.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**30%.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **legislative bill** providing **reservation to women** in state government jobs has been approved by **Uttarakhand Governor**, Lt Gen (Retd.) **Gurmit Singh** in **January 2023.**
 
• **30% reservation** has been approved for women in state government jobs in **Uttarakhand.**
 
• According to the **Uttarakhand Public Services** (Horizontal Reservation for Women) **Bill 2022**, women candidates who permanently reside in Uttarakhand will be given preference for **30% of open positions** in public services and posts after** July 24, 2006, **with** 20%** of the vacancies being filled through **horizontal reservation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reservation **refers to the policy of reserving a certain percentage of seats or positions in **government jobs, educational institutions, **and other areas for certain groups of people who have been historically **disadvantaged or discriminated against**.
 
• In India, **reservation policies** are used to address historical inequalities based on **caste, tribe, gender, **and other factors.
 
• **Women's reservation** in government jobs has been a long-standing demand in India, as women have historically been underrepresented in the public sector workforce.
 
• The approval of this legislative bill in Uttarakhand is a significant step towards increasing** women's representation** and participation in the state government workforce.

questions.question: Butan-2-ol is a:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** secondary alcohol.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Butan-2-ol** has a chemical formula of** C₄H₁₀O **and is a type of alcohol.
 
• It is a **secondary alcohol** because the** hydroxyl (-OH) group** is attached to a carbon atom that is bonded to **two other carbon atoms.**
 
• Butan-2-ol is commonly used as a **solvent **and is also used in the production of other chemicals such as **butyl acetate.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tertiary alcohols **have the hydroxyl group attached to a carbon atom that is bonded to **three other carbon atoms**, while** primary alcohols** have the hydroxyl group attached to a carbon atom that is** bonded to only one** other carbon atom.

 
 
• Tertiary alcohols have a **higher boiling point **than **primary and secondary alcohols** because they have a more **complex molecular structure.**
 
 
 
• **Ketones** have a **carbonyl group (C=O)** in the middle of the carbon chain, which is not present in butan-2-ol.
 
 
• Ketones are commonly used as **solvents **and are also used in the production of **polymers, pharmaceuticals, and other chemicals.**
 
 
 
• **Primary alcohols** can be oxidized to form** aldehydes **and then further oxidized to form **carboxylic acids.**
 
• **Secondary alcohols** can be oxidized to form ketones, but they **cannot be further oxidized** to form carboxylic acids.

questions.question: The outermost cover of plant cells is/are known as ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Cell wall.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **cell wall** is a rigid layer that surrounds the cell membrane of **plant cells, bacteria, fungi, and some protists.**
 
• It provides** structural support and protection **to the cell, and helps maintain its shape.
 
• The cell wall is made up of **cellulose, **a complex carbohydrate that gives it its **strength and rigidity.**
 
• The cell wall also has pores that allow for the **exchange of water, nutrients**, and **gases **between the cell and its environment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** cell membrane** is a **thin, flexible layer **that surrounds the cell and **separates** its internal environment from the external environment.

 
 
• It regulates the **movement of substances** in and out of the cell, and also plays a role in **cell signaling and communication.**
 
 
 
• **Lysosomes** are **membrane-bound organelles** that contain enzymes for breaking down and **recycling cellular waste **and foreign materials.
 
 
• They are found in **animal cells,** but not in plant cells.
 
 
 
• The **Golgi apparatus** is an organelle that sorts, modifies, and packages **proteins and lipids **for transport within the cell or secretion outside the cell.
 
 
• It is made up of a series of **flattened, membrane-bound sacs** called **cisternae.**

questions.question: The Western cyclonic disturbance originates over ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The Mediterranean.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Western cyclonic disturbance** is a weather phenomenon that occurs in the Indian subcontinent and is responsible for the **winter rainfall** in the region.
 
• It is known to originate over the **Mediterranean Sea, **where it gathers **moisture and travels towards** the Indian subcontinent.
 
• The Mediterranean Sea is a large body of water located between **Europe, Asia, and Africa.** 
 
 
• It is known for its **warm and humid climate**, which makes it a favorable environment for the formation of cyclones.
 
 
 
• The **Arabian Sea** and the **Bay of Bengal** are also known for their cyclonic activity, but they are **not** the origin points for the Western cyclonic disturbance.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Arabian Sea** is a part of the Indian Ocean, located between the **Arabian Peninsula** and the **Indian subcontinent**.

 
 
• It is known for its **high sea surface temperatures **and is a **breeding ground** for cyclones.
 
 
 
• The **Bay of Bengal **is another large body of water located in the **northeastern part **of the Indian Ocean, bounded by **India, Bangladesh, and Myanmar.**
 
 
• **​**It is known for its **frequent cyclonic activity**, which is responsible for the monsoon rains in the region.
 
 
 
• The** Pacific Ocean **is the largest body of water on Earth, covering **one-third **of its surface area.
 
 
• It is known for its **typhoons and hurricanes**, which are responsible for a significant amount of **damage and loss of life** in the Pacific Rim countries.

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution empowers the Parliament to establish additional courts for better administration of laws made by it?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 247.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Indian Constitution **provides for a** three-tier judiciary system,** comprising the Supreme Court, High Courts, and subordinate courts.
 
• The Parliament has the power to **establish additional courts t**o deal with specific kinds of cases or to cater to the needs of a particular region or community.
 
• **Article 247 **of the Constitution empowers the Parliament to establish such courts for the **better administration of laws **made by it.
 
• This includes the power to **create tribunals,** which are specialized bodies that adjudicate on specific matters such as **taxation, labor disputes, and environmental issues.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 246 **deals with the distribution of** legislative powers** between the Union and the States.

 
 
• It specifies that Parliament has exclusive power to make laws on matters listed in the** Union List,** while the **State Legislatures** have exclusive power to make laws on matters listed in the State List.
 
• Both the Union and the State Legislatures can make laws on matters listed in the **Concurrent List.**
 
 
 
• **Article 248 **provides for the **residuary powers of legislation**, i.e., the power to make laws on any matter not enumerated in the** three lists.**
 
 
• This power is vested in** Parliament,** subject to the **provisions **of the Constitution.
 
 
 
• **Article 253** empowers the Parliament to make laws for implementing any** international agreement, treaty, or convention**.
 
 
• This power is necessary to fulfill India's obligations under international law and to ensure** uniformity** in the implementation of such agreements across the country.

questions.question: Census in India was first started under ________ in the year 1872.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Mayo.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lord Mayo** was the **Viceroy of India **from **1869 to 1872**, and he introduced the **first regular census** in India in **1872.**
 
• The census was conducted to collect data on **population, literacy, religion, and occupation,** among other things, to assist the colonial government in policymaking and resource allocation.
 
• The census was conducted every** ten years,** and the subsequent censuses were held in** 1881, 1891,** and so on, until the present day.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Lawrence **served as Viceroy of India from** 1864 to 1869**.

 
 
• Lord Lawrence's policy as Viceroy of India focused on **non-intervention** in Indian cultural and religious matters to maintain peace post-1857 Rebellion. He prioritized **infrastructure development**, particularly in railways and irrigation, to support agriculture and prevent famines. His approach to foreign relations was **non-expansionist**, avoiding military interventions and opting for diplomacy. Lawrence's administration emphasized **economic stability** and cautious governance to avoid further unrest.
 
 
 
• **Lord Canning** served as Viceroy of India from **1856 to 1862.**
 
 
• He was responsible for the** administration of India **during the Indian Rebellion of 1857.
 
• He was responsible for the establishment of the Indian Councils Act of 1861, which allowed for the appointment of Indians to legislative councils.
 
 
 
• **Lord Cornwallis** served as Governor-General of India from **1786 to 1793.**
 
 
• He was responsible for introducing several **administrative and judicial reforms** in India, including the establishment of the **Cornwallis Code.**

questions.question: Identify an organism that exhibits metagenesis.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Obelia.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Metagenesis **refers to a type of **alternation of generations** where the **life cycle of an organism** involves both **sexual and asexual **reproduction.
 
• In this process, the offspring of the sexual phase undergo a phase of** asexual reproduction** before they mature into the** sexual phase.**
 
• **Obelia **is a genus of **colonial hydrozoans **that exhibit metagenesis.
 
• They have a complex life cycle that involves both **polyp and medusa stages**, and the polyps undergo asexual reproduction to produce medusae.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Spongilla** is a genus of **freshwater sponges** that do not exhibit metagenesis.

 
 
• They reproduce **sexually **by releasing sperm and eggs into the water, which then develop into** larvae **that settle and grow into adult sponges.
 
 
 
• **Sycon** is a genus of **calcareous sponges** that do not exhibit metagenesis.
 
 
• They reproduce **sexually **by releasing sperm and eggs into the water, which then develop into **free-swimming larvae **that settle and grow into adult sponges.
 
 
 
• **Euspongia **is a genus of **marine sponges** that do not exhibit metagenesis.
 
 
• They reproduce sexually by releasing **sperm and eggs i**nto the water, which then develop into **free-swimming larvae** that settle and grow into adult sponges.

questions.question: Magadha Mahajanapada was surrounded by the rivers ________.

questions.question: Small scale units are differentiated from large scale units on the basis of:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**the amount of investment.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Small scale units** are differentiated from large scale units on the basis of the **amount of investment. **
 
• **Investment** is a key factor because small scale units typically have** less access to funding and resources** than large scale units.
 
• They may rely on personal** savings, loans, or grants** to get started and may have to be **more efficient** with their resources to stay competitive.
 
• The amount of investment can also impact the** growth potential **of a business.
 
• Small scale units may have** limited resources** to expand or develop new products, while large scale units may have more **flexibility** to invest in research and development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The definition of** small scale units** varies by **country and industry**, but generally, they are businesses that require **less investment **and have** fewer employees** than large scale units.
 
• Small scale units may have** lower output and sales volumes** than large scale units, but this is not the defining characteristic. 
 
• A small scale unit could still have high sales and output if it specializes in a** niche market **or has a **unique product.**
 
• The size of the unit area is also **not a defining characteristic **of small scale units. 
 
• A small scale unit could operate out of a** small space or a large one,** depending on its needs.

questions.question: Where did IISCO (Indian Iron and Steel Company) set up its first factory?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Hirapur.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **IISCO (Indian Iron and Steel Company)** was established in **1918** as a public sector undertaking by the government of India.
 
• It was the first integrated steel plant in the **Asia-Pacific region.**
 
• IISCO set up its first factory at **Hirapur.**
 
• IISCO was nationalized in** 1972** and was merged with **Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) **in** 2006.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Roorkie** is a city in the Indian state of **Uttarakhand.**

 
 
• It has an army cantonment and is known for its engineering college,** Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee.**
 
 
 
• **Jamshedpur **is a city in the Indian state of **Jharkhand**.
 
 
• It is known for being the **first planned industrial city** in India and for the **Tata Steel plant **located there.
 
 
 
• **Bhilai** is a city in the Indian state of **Chhattisgarh**.
 
 
• It is known for the **Bhilai Steel Plant**, which is operated by SAIL and is the largest steel plant in India.

questions.question: The number of flights in a 110 m hurdle race is ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**10.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **number of flights** in a **110 m** hurdle race is **10.**
 
• A **hurdle race **is a **track and field event **where athletes run and jump over hurdles that are placed along the track.
 
• The number of flights in a hurdle race refers to the** number of times** an** athlete jumps** over a hurdle.
 
• In a 110 m hurdle race, the hurdles are spaced out at a distance of** 9.14 meters **from each other and the height of the hurdle is** 1.067 meters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Track and field** is a sport that involves** throwing, running, and jumping **competitions.
 
• The **World Athletics Championship **and the **Olympic track and field competition** are now the two most prestigious international events in track and field.
 
• The international body that oversees athletics is called **World Athletics.**

questions.question: Which of the following countries won the highest number of golds in Paralympic-2020?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**China. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **China** won the **highest number of golds** in Paralympic-2020.
 
• China won a total of **96** gold medals in Paralympic-2020, which is the highest number of golds won by any country in the event.
 
• China's success in Paralympic-2020 can be attributed to their strong performance in events like** swimming, athletics, and table tennis**.
 
• China has been a dominant force in Paralympic events for several years and has consistently been one of the** top-performing countries** in the event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Australia **won the** second-highest** number of** golds in Paralympic-2020,** securing a total of** 80** gold medals.

 
 
• Australia's success in the event can be attributed to their strong performance in events like** swimming, cycling, and athletics.**
 
 
 
• The **US **secured the **third position** in the medal tally with a total of** 74 golds** in Paralympic-2020.
 
 
• The US's success in the event can be attributed to their strong performance in events like **swimming, athletics, and wheelchair basketball.**
 
 
 
• **Great Britain** won a total of **41 **gold medals in Paralympic-2020, securing the** fourth position** in the medal tally.
 
 
• Great Britain's success in the event can be attributed to their strong performance in events like **cycling, swimming, and athletics.**

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of revenue receipt of the government?

options.text: Receipts from sale of shares of public sector companies

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**GST collected by the government.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Revenue receipt** refers to the** income** received by the government in the normal course of its business activities, such as** taxes, duties, fees,** and other charges.
 
• **GST (Goods and Services Tax)** is a tax levied on the **supply of goods and services **in India.
 
• It is a **revenue receipt** for the government, as it is collected o**n behalf of the government** by the businesses that are registered under GST.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Receipts from **sale of shares of public sector **companies is a** capital receipt** as it involves the sale of assets.
 
• **Recovery of loans** is also a** capital receipt **as it involves the recovery of loans given by the government.
 
• **Borrowings from public** is a **capital receipt** as it involves the borrowing of funds by the government from the public.
 
• Capital receipts are those that either** increase the government's liabilities** or** lower **the **value of its assets**.
 
 
• In essence, these are the loans that the government has obtained from a variety of sources to pay for **long-term developmental requirements.**
 
• They are **non-recurring** in nature.

questions.question: He was a Delhi Sultan who started the practice of Sijada and Paibos in the court. Who was he?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghiyasuddin Balban.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ghiyasuddin Balban** was a ruler of the **Delhi Sultanate** who reigned from** 1266 to 1287 CE.**
 
• He is known for his **strict policies and authoritarian rule,** which helped him maintain stability in the kingdom.
 
• Balban introduced the practice of **Sijada and Paibos** in the royal court.
 
• **Sijada **was the** act of touching the ground **with **one's forehead **as a sign of respect, while **Paibos **was the act of** kissing the monarch's feet.**
 
• These practices were meant to reinforce the idea of the** ruler's divine right to rule **and to emphasize the **superiority **of the monarch over his subjects.
 
• Balban's reign was marked by several other significant developments, such as the establishment of a **strong central administration**, the creation of a **standing army**, and the construction of several monumental structures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Firoz Shah Tughlaq **was a ruler of the **Tughlaq dynasty** who reigned from **1351 to 1388 CE.**

 
 
• He is known for his patronage of** art and literature** and for his efforts to improve the infrastructure of the kingdom.
 
 
 
• **Iltutmish **was a ruler of the **Slave dynasty** who reigned from **1211 to 1236 CE**.
 
 
• He is credited with establishing the** Delhi Sultanate **as a major power in the Indian subcontinent and for his** military campaigns** against rival kingdoms.
 
 
 
• **Ibrahim Lodhi **was a ruler of the **Lodhi dynasty **who reigned from **1517 to 1526 CE.**
 
 
• He is known for his defeat at the hands of the Mughal emperor **Babur in the Battle of Panipat,** which marked the** end of the Delhi Sultanate** and the beginning of the** Mughal Empire.**
